bear_assumptions: Apply 14x to the USD 18.10 low end of 2026 adjusted-EPS guidance as reimbursement, execution, leverage and cash-conversion risks compress the multiple.
base_assumptions: Apply 17x to the USD 18.325 guidance midpoint as mid-single-digit growth, margin execution and recurring testing demand offset leverage and integration risk.
bull_assumptions: Apply 20x to the USD 18.55 guidance high end as backlog conversion, specialty testing, margin expansion, cash generation and capital allocation outperform.
rating_change_conditions: Upgrade only if a lower price or stronger primary evidence on organic growth, segment margins, backlog conversion, free cash flow, leverage and long-term Investor Day targets clears expected-return, base-return, downside-payoff, margin-of-safety and relationship gates; downgrade the thesis if reimbursement, leadership execution, volumes, margins, backlog or cash conversion deteriorates.
